|joke=The title is Greedo's subtitled line to Han in the Mos Eisley cantina in ''Star Wars'',<ref name="imsdb-anh">[https://imsdb.com/scripts/Star-Wars-A-New-Hope.html Star Wars: A New Hope script], IMSDb. I've been looking forward to this for a long time",<ref name="wook-greedo-legends">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Greedo/Legends Greedo], Wookieepedia (Legends). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260526042401/https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Greedo/Legends Internet Archive], 26 May 2026.</ref> which the short story "A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale" in ''Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina'' writes as "Ukle nyuma cheskopokuta klees ka tlanko ya oska".<ref name="wermo-huttese">[https://www.completewermosguide.com/hutttranscript.html Huttese Transcript], The Complete Wermo's Guide to Huttese & Other Star Wars Languages (section on ''Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina''). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260705043914/https://www.completewermosguide.com/hutttranscript.html Internet Archive], 5 July 2026.</ref> The card gives them with no subtitle. It is part of the running gag of cards that print alien speech and sounds without a translation. See [[Jokes#Alien speech and sounds|Jokes]].
